criticalSteps.heading: Prepare the beef and mushrooms
criticalSteps.requiredCue: Beef slices are even; mushrooms are dry and clean with broad surfaces for browning.

criticalSteps.heading: Make the soy-onion marinade
criticalSteps.requiredCue: The marinade is uniform and lightly thickened by onion.

criticalSteps.heading: Marinate in stages
criticalSteps.requiredCue: Beef is coated and mushrooms are glossy but not waterlogged.

criticalSteps.heading: Preheat the approved grill
